content.test_md_blob:
# Validate empty required sales-form input without submission

> Prove that leaving required sales-form input empty triggers inline validation on the sales form without completing a real lead submission.

## Step 1

Open https://www.twilio.com/en-us in a new browser session as an anonymous visitor.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-2

From the homepage, use a visible Contact sales control to open the sales contact page, then assert the sales form shows at least one interactive field ready for input.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-3, ac-5

On the sales contact form, focus a required field and leave it as an empty string by blurring it without entering any characters, then assert inline validation is shown for the field and the sales form remains visible on the sales contact page for correction.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-3, ac-5

On the same required field or another required field on the same form, enter a single space and blur the field, then assert inline validation is shown again and the sales form remains visible on the sales contact page for correction.

content.title: Reach the sales contact form from every visible homepage Contact sales control

check.operand: visible Contact sales control opens the sales contact page

content.test_md_blob:
# Reach the sales contact form from every visible homepage Contact sales control

> Prove that the anonymous visitor can use a visible homepage Contact sales control to open the sales contact page and reach the rendered sales form.

## Step 1

Open https://www.twilio.com/en-us in a new browser session as an anonymous visitor.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-1

On the homepage, identify every visible Contact sales control and open each one in turn, returning to the homepage between checks as needed, then assert each control loads the sales contact page.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-2

On the sales contact page reached from the last Contact sales control checked, inspect the form area, then assert at least one interactive sales form field is visible.

objectives:
  - objective: Open https://www.twilio.com/en-us in a new browser session as an anonymous visitor.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored

      operator: forall
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-1
    objective: On the homepage, identify every visible Contact sales control and open each one in turn, returning to the homepage between checks as needed, then assert each control loads the sales contact page.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-1
  - objective: On the sales contact page reached from the last Contact sales control checked, inspect the form area, then assert at least one interactive sales form field is visible.
    step: 3
    verifies:
      - ac-2

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Kept at highest value because empty-input validation is explicit P0 source coverage and a regression here would let bad lead data proceed farther into the conversion path.
[value_score] Kept at highest value because malformed-input validation is explicit P0 source coverage and complements empty-input handling with a distinct invalid-data family.

[value_score] Kept because CTA routing to the contact form is the entry condition for the whole assisted-conversion path, though its risk is slightly lower than the invalid-input guards once the form is reached.

[self_critique] The oracle proves the promised behavior at the browser surface by observing inline validation and continued form presence after empty invalid values. I avoided an over-broad assertion about exact validation copy because the source does not specify message text.

[self_critique] The technique fits the malformed-input path by using the source-backed invalid address shapes and asserting the observable client-side response. I avoided inventing a specific field inventory by constraining the step to a format-constrained field that the live form exposes.

[self_critique] The oracle proves the forall routing promise by covering every visible homepage Contact sales control rather than a single example, and the form-render assertion is kept separate so it does not over-claim field completeness the source never enumerated.
